description: Stable error codes for Workflow Runtime HTTP endpoints

400.invalid_json: request body is not valid for this endpoint
400.invalid_idempotency_key: Idempotency-Key must be 1-128 visible ASCII characters

401.unauthenticated: Bearer token is missing, malformed, or invalid in test_hs256 mode
401.missing_claim: access token is missing a required claim in test_hs256 mode
401.malformed_token: JWT or required claims are malformed in jwks mode
401.unknown_kid: JWT key ID remains unknown after refresh

403.canary_read_only: service is in canary read-only mode, write endpoints are disabled
403.cross_domain_violation: definition version does not belong to the domain
403.principal_not_assignee: principal is not the current assignee
403.global_coordinator_required: caller must hold the GLOBAL_WORKFLOW_COORDINATOR role
403.restricted_history_not_visible: restricted workflow history is not visible
403.direct_token_required: only direct access tokens may perform this operation
403.not_domain_owner: caller is not a domain owner

404.workflow_instance_not_found_or_not_visib: workflow instance not found or not visible
404.assistance_case_not_found_or_not_visible: assistance case not found or not visible

409.workflow_state_version_conflict: workflow state version does not match
409.principal_projection_conflict: principal exists with a different type
409.principal_is_owner: principal is a domain owner and cannot be a member
409.definition_key_conflict: definition key already exists in this domain
409.definition_version_immutable: definition version is not in DRAFT status
409.assistance_open: current visit has an unresolved assistance case
409.assistance_already_open: current visit already has an unresolved assistance case
409.assistance_status_conflict: assistance case is not in the required state
409.current_node_visit_mismatch: current node visit does not match the request
409.domain_owner_missing: domain does not have exactly one effective owner

413.size_limit_exceeded: request field exceeds its size limit

422.assignee_resolution_failed: initial/target assignee could not be resolved
422.invalid_return_references: return references are invalid (details.detail carries the specific missing/invalid RETURN contract field)
422.invalid_filter: query filter is invalid for this assistance view

details.description: Optional error details, omitted when empty
